RagShortTexts: Königsberg needs food, materials and transport for its garrison.
A founded strongpoint does not ensure obedience across Sambia.

Variants.Content: Königsberg concentrates garrison, messages and land-sea transport, while Sambian communities retain their interests. Food, timber and labor must keep arriving. Building and residence burden nearby people, and roads need actual support.
A developing post needs guards for works, stores and arrivals. Materials still require unloading; pursuit must not remove everyone needed at the landing.
Königsberg carries continuing costs after visiting forces depart. Local labor demands must leave a harvest; destroying neighboring supply undermines the strongpoint itself.
Neighbors gain selling opportunities but face requisitions. Secure fields and payment for work determine whether they keep supplying the post or avoid it.
